name: 32224 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32224 (Jacksonville) has 147 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32224 (Jacksonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32224 (Jacksonville) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
